summary.zh: 教务、在线教学、体育场馆与网费
summary.en: Academics, LMS, gym, and campus network

description.zh: 使用 Node.js sysu CLI 查询课表、成绩、考试、公告、在线教学、场馆预约、网费与统一认证换票；账号密码只在插件页使用
description.en:
Query timetable, grades, exams, notices, online courses, gym bookings, campus network, and SSO tickets with the Node.js sysu CLI inside the Linux runtime.
Sign-in and credentials are handled on the plugin page, and the CLI installs automatically on first use.
